*Vector dark matter / Higgs portal · model.*

Extract hidden Abelian gauge fields, the fields needed for vector mass generation, the stabilizing parity, and Higgs portal interactions. Separate Higgs and Stueckelberg realizations and identify the assumptions underlying any effective vector description. Record symmetry origins and coupling restrictions without treating historical Higgs or dark matter constraints as present status.

papers.title: UFO - The Universal FeynRules Output
papers.seed_scope_text:
**C. Degrande et al. (2011). [1108.2040v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1108.2040v2).**

*Model representation / interchange format · tool.*

Map particles, parameters, interactions, Lorentz structures, and color structures from the UFO representation to atlas records. Track basis choices, parameter dependencies, and conventions required for an exported implementation. Treat UFO files as representations of model specifications, preserving the distinction between a generator interface and evidence for the original theory.

papers.title: Dimension-Six Terms in the Standard Model Lagrangian

**B. Grzadkowski, M. Iskrzynski, M. Misiak and J. Rosiek (2010). [1008.4884v3](https://arxiv.org/abs/1008.4884v3).**

*Effective theories and matching · classification.*

Record the dimension-six SMEFT basis, flavor conventions, conservation assumptions and treatment of redundant operators. Begin with representative operators from distinct sectors. Distinguish an operator basis from a model specification and retain the truncation and field content of the effective description; an operator does not by itself identify a unique high-energy theory.

papers.title: Effective description of general extensions of the Standard Model: the complete tree-level dictionary
papers.seed_scope_text:
**J. de Blas, J. C. Criado, M. Perez-Victoria and J. Santiago (2017). [1711.10391v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10391v2).**

*Effective theories and matching · classification.*

Extract representative scalar, fermion and vector matching examples, linking heavy-field representations and interactions to dimension-six SMEFT coefficients. Record tree-level scope, basis and matching assumptions on the relation. The high-energy theory is not assumed renormalizable in this work; retain that scope and distinguish a partial matching example from a complete ultraviolet model.
